5763972.name: Chabad of Columbia County
5763972.note: COLlive, 28 May 2023 ('New Shluchim to Columbia County, New York'): 'Rabbi Mendel and Rochie Kremer, along with their two children, will be moving to Columbia County, New York to establish the first Chabad House in the county'; 'With the establishment of Chabad of Columbia County'. Before the move they ran programmes there: 'From our public Menorah lighting, to seeing the reaction to our children walking the streets in their Purim costumes and to receiving their first box of Shmura Matza' (so from about Chanukah 2022). They were brought by Rabbi Yisroel Rubin and Rabbi Mendel Rubin. Its chabad.org listing went up 5 Jan 2023.

6820138.name: Chabad of SUNY Plattsburgh
6820138.note: COLlive, 3 Aug 2025 ('New Campus Shluchim to SUNY Plattsburgh, NY'): 'Rabbi Meir Aharon Goldberg and his wife, Leah, will arrive in Plattsburgh, NY, in mid-August to establish an independent Chabad center at SUNY Plattsburgh'; before that, 'For the last several months Rabbi Goldberg and his wife visited the campus during rosh hashana to give out high holiday packages, sukkos with a sukkah mobile, hosted a chanukah party and many fridays giving out neshek and wrapping tefillin' (visits from about Rosh Hashana 2024). Its chabad.org listing went up 28 July 2025.

2840155.name: Chabad of Rock Hill
2840155.note: Rabbi Simcha and Chany Zajac on COLlive, 18 May 2016 ('New Chabad House in Catskills', their campaign to buy a building): 'we moved to Rock Hill, a centrally located, quiet, and beautiful community to serve the Sullivan County Jewish community'; 'Working out of different rentals for the past two years'. Medium: counted back (two years before May 2016); its chabad.org listing went up 26 Jan 2015.
